packages/db/src/lonora_db/usage.py.name: Usage store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/usage.py.description: Works out usage and cost per agent, model and time, with the spreadsheet export; a view only, with no cap.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/voice_notes.py.name: Voice notes store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/voice_notes.py.description: Holds the owner's voice notes until their transcript is ready, then lets the agent answer.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/voice_provenan.name: Voice provenance store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/voice_provenan.description: Carries a voice request's provenance onto the run that re-asks it.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/workspace_give.name: Given secrets store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/workspace_give.description: Keeps, encrypted for a while, the secret values given to workspace commands, so the output scan still covers them.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/workspace_proc.name: Workspace processes store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/workspace_proc.description: Tracks the background processes an agent started until it is told they ended.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/workspace_runn.name: What-is-running store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/workspace_runn.description: Records what is running in the workspace and carries out the owner's stop requests.

packages/db/src/lonora_db/workspace_wake.name: Workspace wakes store
packages/db/src/lonora_db/workspace_wake.description: Handles the `lonora wake` command that wakes an agent by its handle.
